author: Good Enough
description:
An ordinary pen once became part of the strange world of Cold War espionage.

Designed to look completely harmless, this modified pen concealed a hidden mechanism that allowed spies to carry out covert operations without drawing attention. Small enough to fit in a pocket, it showed how everyday objects could be transformed into secret tools during the height of the Cold War.

This Short explores one of the most unusual spy devices ever created and the hidden purpose behind it.
